name: Carbon-fibre rods, 6 mm x 450 mm
spec: Solid or thick-wall tube, 6 mm dia
notes: Cut to 425 mm, deburr, seal ends with CA.

name: Stack plates (battery, PCB, telemetry)
notes: Print flat, 4 perimeters, 40% gyroid.

name: Landing frame (diamond plate with four hinge lugs)
spec: PA-CF recommended: heat from the motor and landing loads

name: Landing legs 8 mm x 300 mm + rubber feet
spec: Carbon or aluminium tube, hinged at the landing-frame corner lugs
notes: 34 deg from vertical, footprint 510 mm

name: Leg braces (1.6 mm steel or CF rod)
spec: From gimbal mount to leg mid-point

name: Gimbal printed parts (mount, outer ring, collar)
notes: Keep clear of exhaust: add a heat shield disc (G-06).

name: Gear sector 36T + pinion 18T, module 1 (set)
spec: Acetal, nylon or printed PA; CAD names gear36t1 / gear36t2
notes: 2:1 reduction: servo travel = 2x gimbal travel.

name: Digital metal-gear servo, 20 g class, HV
notes: Prefer a metal case for heat; buy a spare.

name: Pivot pins M3 x 60 + 683ZZ bearings
notes: Zero play is a requirement: shim until backlash < 0.3 deg.

name: Service-loop cable for servo 2
notes: Servo 2 rides on the outer ring.

name: Heat shield disc / ablative ring
notes: Aluminium disc under the gimbal; protects printed parts and wiring near the nozzle.

name: Motor tube 29 mm ID, G10 / phenolic, 200 mm
notes: Clamped by the gimbal collar; do not glue in.

name: 29 mm certified composite reload (consumable)
spec: F class first (≈ 25-35 N avg, 20-40 N·s, ≈ 100 g); G class later (60-120 N avg, ≈ 155 g loaded: mass counted here is the G worst case); delay/ejection NOT used
notes: Certified motors only (NAR/Tripoli/CAR). Check local law and range rules.

name: LiPo 2S 850 mAh, 30C+ (avionics pack A, white tag)
LiPo 2S 850 mAh, 30C+ (servo pack B, orange tag)
spec: 7.4 V nominal; HV servos run directly from it via fuse
notes: Separate pack keeps servo stall current away from the flight computer.

name: Fuse / PTC (5 A) + remove-before-flight pin + arm switch
spec: RBF pin must be removable with gloves

name: Wiring harness, connectors, heat shrink
notes: No bare Dupont connectors on a rocket: vibration.

name: IMU ICM-42688-P
notes: Mount near the stack axis.

name: Barometer BMP390
notes: Vent the frame; avoid sealed cavities.

name: High-g accelerometer ADXL375 (optional)
notes: Optional; improves event detection.

name: GPS u-blox M10 module
notes: Top frame, antenna clear of carbon rods.

name: LoRa telemetry module (region band) + whip antenna
notes: Check licence and power limits in your country.

name: Pyro driver (2 ch, MOSFET + continuity sense)
notes: Parachute-release channel + one spare. The motor is lit by the ground ignition controller, never by this board.

name: Recovery: parachute 24-36 in + shock cord + release servo (baseline option)
notes: Deployment is tested on the ground with a dummy mass.

name: Test stand: base, deflector, 20 kg load cell + HX711
notes: See docs/phase2-rocket/07-test-stand-procedure.md

name: Ignition controller (12 V, continuity check, safety key) + leads
notes: Cable length per motor class and range safety distance.

name: Fire extinguisher, water, gloves, eye protection
notes: Non-negotiable at every firing.
